name: @uptimebuyer/kite-broker
description: The exclusive Kite payment broker service (M09): the ONLY holder of the Kite/paid-endpoint credential and the only paid egress. Accepts signed opaque execution references over a 0600 unix socket, reloads every bound fact from PostgreSQL, linearizes reserve + SEND_STARTED, executes through broker-owned adapters and reconciles UNKNOWN only by authoritative lookup or provider-guaranteed same-key replay. Deliberately exports nothing: credential-bearing code is not importable.
